verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe capturing the follow-up work an incident leaves behind and tracking it to completion. The integrations directory says follow-ups can be exported as GitHub or GitLab Issues with changes synced, and incident actions can be exported and auto-synced with Asana tickets. Webhooks are also cited for keeping track of follow-ups. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on corroboration of the sync, no detail on whether sync is bidirectional for follow-ups or how completion status flows back, and no evidence of leader-level reporting on follow-up completion (only post-mortem completion tracking is documented).
